summary_1line: Empowered by Vishnu and the gods, Indra hurls the Vajra and kills Vritra, after which the surviving Danavas retreat to the ocean and plot to destroy ascetics.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra, blazing with the combined energy of gods and sages, hurls the thunderbolt Vajra at the towering Asura Vritra amid a sky-shaking battle.
Severed heads fall from the sky like palmyra fruits as gods and Danavas clash with swords and maces in a terrifying celestial battlefield.
The gigantic Vritra roars so fiercely that the earth, mountains, and heavens tremble while the gods recoil in fear.
